snippet.title: No Rest for Lex trailer
snippet.description:
Neither Rex nor truffle manager Lex now enjoys a quiet life... No way! Realities have overlapped and everyone comes to him looking for answers. As if he had them! Maybe getting lost is the only way to find his place.
